criterios.renda: Incremental margin of the 2nd season (municipality PAM yield × SEAB/DERAL price − CONAB cost; cover/fallow = −estimated cost; plus the straw/N bonus in the following soybean; off-season corn, corn + brachiaria and wheat at the realized mean of the last 5 seasons in the municipality, when there is a track record), on the scale S = R$ 1,110/ha, the same in all of Paraná (median soybean margin in Western Paraná): income = 0.5 + 0.5·tanh(incremental / S). Incremental zero = 0.5; +S ≈ 0.88; −S ≈ 0.12.
criterios.solo: Mean of straw cover, N fixation and (1 − days of bare soil/180); catalog values (reference estimates, validate with an agronomist/Embrapa).
criterios.agua: Mean over 34 years (1991–2024) of ΣETa/ΣETc in the critical phase of the 2nd crop, by daily water balance (NASA POWER + polygon soil AWC, SoilGrids); depends on the sowing date. Fallow = 1.0.
criterios.pragas: Potential to break the pest and disease cycle per rotation; catalog value (0–1), estimate to validate.
criterios.risco: Π(1 − p) of the 2nd-crop climate risks in 1991–2024: frost in the critical phase (NASA POWER cell ~50 km) and water deficit in the critical phase (years with ETa/ETc < 0.55 in the daily balance with the area's soil; without soil, dry spell ≥ 15 days in Mar–Apr); no risk considered = 1.0.
